reason: The README clearly identifies this repository as a reusable template and scaffold for developing DSH plugins, with an example tool and local validation workflow; it is not itself an installable plugin.

summaries.zh: 用于通过模板和脚手架创建、配置及本地验证 DSH 工具插件的开发辅助仓库。
summaries.en: A development template and scaffolding utility for creating, configuring, and locally validating DSH tool plugins.

capabilities: Provides a scaffold template for creating DSH bundle plugins
Includes a shell script that generates a new plugin directory
Demonstrates defining and self-testing a placeholder tool through the DSH execution pipeline
